svg.text: mean cursor error per presentation (px), axis starts at 0
Each marker is one target presentation (the mean over its valid measurement samples), not
one camera frame. Reference lines are across the 32 eligible presentation means; the p95 is
Values at a screen edge among valid measurement samples: 4 cursor values and 13 model values at the bottom edge (y = 1.0). The log stores only values
bounded to the screen and has no clip flag, so these are not confirmed clipping events.
Spatial values use valid measurement samples only; settling samples and invalid predictions are excluded (invalid attempts remain in the coverage
card). Targets are the instructed fixation points, not measured gaze.
